# @scramjet/runner

This package is part of Scramjet Transform Hub. The package executes the remote runners and provides communication with them through abstraction layer provided by adapters.

## Install

```bash
npm install @scramjet/runner
```

## Import

```typescript
import { /* ... */ } from "@scramjet/runner";
```

## Documentation

See the [package docs](https://github.com/scramjetorg/transform-hub/tree/HEAD/packages/runner) for full documentation.
